caseName: Lone Star Gas Co. v. Texas
caseNameFull: Lone Star Gas Co. v. Texas

opinions.text: It is ordered that the opinion in this cause be amended by striking the word “interstate” from the ninth *552line on page four thereof and substituting the word “intrastate” therefor, so that the sentence will read: “The fair value of its intrastate property was thus claimed to be $38,350,882.32 and the net amount available at the Commission’s rate for return on intrastate deliveries of gas as less than four per cent.” Reported as amended, ante, p. 224.
